podcasts.name: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.title: California Encounter (1936)
podcast.body: Woody Guthrie's cousin, Jack Guthrie, was a western singer in California in 1936, performing a style of western swing that foreshadowed rockabilly. "he'd hooked up with a cousin, Jack Guthrie, who was a western singer, performing the kind of western swing that would later become rockabilly."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
srcs.episode: Episode 97: "Song to Woody" by Bob Dylan

podcast.title: The Oki and Woody Show
podcast.body: Jack was the lead singer and guitarist for "The Oki and Woody Show," a radio program he had with Woody Guthrie and the Beverly Hillbillies. He eventually gave up the show due to its lack of success. "Jack was the lead singer and guitarist, and Woody was his comedy sidekick backing vocalist and harmonica player."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
